features: 1-Inch 8K/60fps HDR 360° Imaging* - Powered by 1-inch 360° imaging* and a new high-performance chip, this 8K 360 camera delivers native 8K/60fps video.
AI SuperNight 2.0 - With an f/1.9 aperture and an all-new AI image noise reduction algorithm, this 360 camera captures exceptionally clean, bright low-light shots*.
Ultra-Hard, Scratch-Resistant Lenses* With a Replaceable Design - With the user-replaceable design, this 8K 360 camera lets you swap a damaged lens in seconds.

Smart Editing, Instant Sharing - Skip the manual grading. This DJI 360 camera analyzes your footage and applies built-in Pro filters in the DJI Mimo app, turning raw clips into ready-to-share videos with one tap.

Osmo All-Scenario Ecosystem - An Osmo dual-direction quick-release and 1/4′′ thread let this 360 camera connect to Osmo accessories and traditional camera gear, unlocking a unique angle for motorcycling, diving, and skiing.
105GB Built-in Storage - With 105GB of built-in storage, this 8K 360 camera is ready the moment you power on—no extra memory cards, no extra expense or hassle.
4-in-1 Powerhouse, Create in Three Steps - More than a 360 camera, it captures action POVs and simulates gimbal- and drone-style views.
Includes Osmo 360 II, an Extreme Battery Plus, a Protective Pouch, and more. An ideal choice for everyday 360° creation.

Due to platform compatibility issues, the DJI Mimo app has been removed from Google Play. For a better product experience, please visit the official DJI website to download the latest version of DJI Mimo.
